cards.title: Asset Allocation 100 - Age Rule ⚖️
cards.content:
Equity Allocation % = **100 - Your Age**.

At Age 20: 80% Equity (Mutual Funds/Stocks) + 20% Debt (PPF/FD/Gold).
At Age 50: 50% Equity + 50% Debt.
cards.imagePrompt: Balance scale with stocks pie chart on one side and gold bar on the other, gold theme

cards.title: Physical Gold vs SGB (Sovereign Gold Bond) 🥇
cards.content:
Physical Gold: Making charges loss (10-25%) + Locker security risk.
SGB: 2.5% annual interest income + 0% making charge + Tax-Free capital gains after 8 years!
cards.imagePrompt: Gold coin with Government of India crest seal

choiceData.scenario: Gold mein ₹50,000 long-term invest karna hai. Physical Jewellery vs SGB?

choices.consequence: Smart! Extra 2.5% annual interest + Tax-free maturity.
